question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Dracula, Bob gets Middlemarch, Claire gets Jane Eyre, Dave gets Ivanhoe, Eve gets Hamlet, Fred gets The Hobbit, and Gertrude gets Walden.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Alice and Bob swap books. Then, Dave and Alice swap books. Then, Eve and Dave swap books. Then, Claire and Dave swap books. Then, Alice and Dave swap books. Then, Dave and Bob swap books. Finally, Gertrude and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Bob has
Options:
(A) Dracula
(B) Middlemarch
(C) Jane Eyre
(D) Ivanhoe
(E) Hamlet
(F) The Hobbit
(G) Walden
solution:
Reader order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: Dracula | Middlemarch | Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | Hamlet | The Hobbit | Walden
1. Alice ↔ Bob: Middlemarch | Dracula | Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | Hamlet | The Hobbit | Walden
2. Dave ↔ Alice: Ivanhoe | Dracula | Jane Eyre | Middlemarch | Hamlet | The Hobbit | Walden
3. Eve ↔ Dave: Ivanhoe | Dracula | Jane Eyre | Hamlet | Middlemarch | The Hobbit | Walden
4. Claire ↔ Dave: Ivanhoe | Dracula | Hamlet | Jane Eyre | Middlemarch | The Hobbit | Walden
5. Alice ↔ Dave: Jane Eyre | Dracula | Hamlet | Ivanhoe | Middlemarch | The Hobbit | Walden
6. Dave ↔ Bob: Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | Hamlet | Dracula | Middlemarch | The Hobbit | Walden
7. Gertrude ↔ Bob: Jane Eyre | Walden | Hamlet | Dracula | Middlemarch | The Hobbit | Ivanhoe
Bob has Walden, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
